equity_evidence: Latest actually observed LIVE daily TRADE_SETUP visible at candidate observation, at most one exchange-session old, not expired, failed or conflicted. Treat as unqualified context, not a forecast or gate override
selection: First observed candidate matrix per underlyer/strategy/structure/exchange-session; preserve raw candidate_rank. Option-only is its first horizon-eligible package; equity arm is its first ALIGNED horizon-eligible package, otherwise abstain. Do not use outcomes in choosing rows
raw_activity: Retain research-only option detector alerts and conflicts as context; no option P/L or directional trade inferred from detector activity
horizon_definition: Candidate's persisted entry marks to regular close of the fifth, tenth or twenty-first subsequent XNYS session. Every leg must expire strictly after that exit date. This is not a shorter-horizon refitted equity model
entry: Existing candidate marks with matching current valuation policy and actual decision-visible entry snapshot; delayed indicative prices are not executable fills
exit: One coherent saved batch scheduled at the exact target close; snapshot quote/mark times may precede that close within the valuation policy age/skew limits. Require matching contract identity/terms. No other-cycle or later-date fallback or theoretical substitution
costs: Reuse versioned option outcome commission policy; unavailable spread/slippage remains disclosed. Do not multiply option returns by stock returns or equity model scores
calendar: Persisted near-term event state does not certify earnings/Fed coverage through 5/10/21 sessions; mark full-horizon event coverage UNVERIFIED
inference: Descriptive only. Group by strategy, structure and horizon; report distinct entry sessions, repeated packages, missingness and abstentions. Compare matched dates and zero-return abstention separately, never call repeated candidates independent trials
baseline_limit: Option-only means unchanged persisted candidate ranking, not a replay of detection with all original equity filters removed; label prefiltered candidate set
scope: Read-only separate report. No database writes, alert reranking, gate changes, model fitting, new provider data or modifications to the running equity paper tracker
